description: A script for extracting and generating a subset of OpenGL ES 2.0 symbols compatible across platforms, by parsing header files and creating macro definitions.

methods.name: add_defines_to_set
methods.description: Parses a header file to extract symbols defined with #define, typedefs, and gl-prefixed symbols.

methods.name: extract_common_symbols
methods.description: Compares two sets of symbols to find common or related symbols, generating #define directives for renaming.
